worldcombat.skill.honeclaws.summary: The user crosses its claws and scrapes them in a few quick passes to sharpen them, raising Attack and accuracy by one stage each. The edge lasts for a visible window and is taken back when it ends; both the wind-up and the cooldown are short, so it can be re-applied again and again.
worldcombat.skill.honeclaws.use.0: A couple of passes before the fight to raise Attack and accuracy together
worldcombat.skill.honeclaws.use.1: Top the edge back up when accuracy has been cut or combos are whiffing
worldcombat.skill.honeclaws.use.2: Keep the edge fresh with the shortest window of the family
Raise Attack by %1$s stages and accuracy by %2$s stages.
The edge lasts %1$s; when it ends the Attack and accuracy it raised are taken back.
worldcombat.skill.honeclaws.deep.on: Deep hone: Attack rises one more stage, at the cost of a 4-tick longer wind-up, 10 ticks more cooldown and the edge window multiplied by 0.7 - keen but hard to keep.
worldcombat.skill.honeclaws.deep.off: Quick hone: Attack only +1, but faster, with a longer window and a shorter cooldown, fit for a long trade.
worldcombat.skill.honeclaws.timing: A self move with %1$s blocks of range; after %2$s s of wind-up it spends %4$s PP, then recovers for %3$s s with a %5$s s cooldown committed on cast.
worldcombat.skill.honeclaws.growth.0: At level %1$s the edge window stretches to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.honeclaws.growth.1: At level %1$s the edge window stretches further to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.honeclaws.preference.d: On: Attack rises one more stage, at the cost of a 4-tick longer wind-up, 10 ticks more cooldown and the edge window multiplied by 0.7. Off: quick hone, faster with a longer window and a shorter cooldown, but Attack only +1.
worldcombat.skill.honeclaws.preference.a: The move is considered only against a threat within this distance; larger means sharpening earlier.
A threat closer than this makes the companion attack instead of sharpening; larger gives up the hone more often up close.
world_combat.move.honeclaws.text.capped: The edge is already at its limit - nothing was honed this time
When the edge runs out or is cleared early, the Attack and accuracy it added are taken back by the amount actually gained; if a stat is already at its cap, less is added and only that much is taken back.
